concept: ERC-4626 vault inflation attack: a donation inflates the share price so a victim's deposit rounds down to zero shares
scene: Technical diagram on a deep navy background. On the left, a vault box holding a single share token. An amber arrow labeled as a direct transfer enters the vault from the side, bypassing the deposit door. On the right, a victim's deposit of 100 tokens approaches the vault and turns into an empty share slot showing zero. Clean thin line art, monospace labels, ample spacing, calm engineering feel.
alt_text: Diagram of a vault holding one share while a direct token transfer inflates its balance and a victim's deposit converts to zero shares.
